decisions.migration_notes: curated/identity/conditional-access/policies gains a plan-time precondition: grant_controls.operator = "AND" now needs at least two grant controls; built-in controls, terms of use and an authentication strength count together. Microsoft Graph keeps OR for a single grant control, so AND with one control planned a permanent difference; it now fails at plan with an error that explains this. Set operator to "OR", or add a second grant control.
decisions.summary: Refuse grant_controls.operator AND with a single grant control in the Conditional Access policy module

decisions.migration_notes: This is the first versioned release, v1.0.0, of the Terraform Registry module satolap/modules/msgraph; earlier releases were tagged with input fingerprints and are withdrawn. The catalogs moved to the repository root: generated modules are at <api-version>/<graph-route> and curated modules at curated/<module-path>, so a registry source reads satolap/modules/msgraph//v1.0/<graph-route>, satolap/modules/msgraph//beta/<graph-route> or satolap/modules/msgraph//curated/<module-path>, with a version. A generated module's directory is its Graph route without the documentation category it was filed under before: modules/generated/v1.0/applications/applications is now v1.0/applications, and modules/generated/v1.0/mail/users/by-user-id/messages is now v1.0/users/by-user-id/messages. Categories group modules in each catalog README. Five beta security modules moved onto paths that earlier releases used for other endpoints: the sensitivity-labels module of /security/informationProtection/sensitivityLabels is now beta/security/information-protection/sensitivity-labels and that of /informationProtection/sensitivityLabels is beta/information-protection/sensitivity-labels; the four /security/threatSubmission modules are under beta/security/threat-submission and the four /threatSubmission modules under beta/threat-submission. No module interface changed. To move a configuration from an earlier release, change each source to the new path and add a version; keep the module block names so Terraform keeps the existing state.
decisions.summary: Publish every module at its Microsoft Graph route as the first versioned release
